title: Reconnect jitter: up to 1 s in the reference product, up to 50% of the wait in ours (row 11 gap G-11-1)
reference_behaviour: The live-price socket in the browser waits a capped, doubling delay before each reconnect and adds a random spread of at most one second to it (bundle-findings 6.1; no screen shows it).
ours: SPEC CHANGE: REQ-114 AC-3 (approved) adds random jitter of up to 50% of the wait, so up to 15 s at the 30 s cap; copying means at most 1 s.
